description: This file defines a class PreMigrationCheck that extends AbstractInstallerRestController. It handles a POST request to perform pre-migration checks such as database user permission evaluation and resetting migration state in an OrangeHRM system installer context.

classes.name: PreMigrationCheck
classes.description: A controller class handling POST requests to perform pre-migration database permission checks and update migration state.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests by evaluating database user permissions and resetting migration completion state.
